summary: Comprehensive full-stack testing of GLOO POS iteration 1. All 14 requested flows verified end-to-end via public URL. Backend smoke suite (13/13 tests) covers auth, RBAC, POS catalog, subscription, platform, PWA static assets, and txn number format. Frontend Playwright covered: invalid login error, cashier login+dashboard+nav-gating+online-indicator, full POS flow (open-shift already open, product grid with Coffee/Tea/Food/Snack, Latte variant modal with Large+Extra Shot, cart total Rp 43.000, subtotal+10% tax+5% service = Rp 49.450, cash payment with Exact button, receipt modal with T001-O01-U003-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-NNNNNN, Print/New Sale buttons), cashier orders list (no Void button — correct RBAC), owner login (Management/Operations/Team/Settings sidebar groups), Subscription page (Pro/ACTIVE, Outlets 2/10, Users 4/50, all 10 features enabled incl Advanced Reports), categories create, cashier shift page (current shift, cash in/out, history, daily journal), users & roles (4 seed users), owner void PAID order → status VOID with success toast, platform admin (Tenants list with plan/status/usage, Subscription modal opens with plan/status/reason inputs), Plans page (all 4 plans FREE/BASIC/PRO/ENTERPRISE with features and outlet/user limits), mobile 390px POS (no horizontal overflow, stacked layout).

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)' — a setState is being called during Login render (likely useEffect or redirect logic dispatched during render). Harmless in prod but should be fixed to avoid concurrent-mode issues.
Modal container is missing role="dialog" attribute (queried with document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]') returned null). Minor accessibility issue — screen readers won't announce it correctly.

Plan cards (FREE/BASIC/PRO/ENTERPRISE) have no visible Edit affordance — no 'Edit' button or hover indicator. User discovers edit only by clicking the whole card. Consider adding an explicit Edit button/icon per card.

issues: Transaction number 'T001-O01-U003-...' rendered in monospace font where capital O and digit 0 look nearly identical, causing potential ambiguity when reading. Consider using a font with disambiguated O/0 or adding subtle color/weight differentiation.

action_items: (LOW) Add role="dialog" to platform tenant Subscription modal container
(LOW) Add explicit 'Edit' button/icon on platform plan cards so users know cards are clickable to edit
critical_code_review_comments: Auth flow uses httpOnly cookies over https as expected; API also accepts Bearer tokens — good.
Txn number format from API: T001-O01-U003-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-NNNNNN matches spec exactly (verified via /api/orders).
Server-authoritative totals confirmed: cart Rp 43.000 subtotal → tax 10% Rp 4.300 → service 5% Rp 2.150 → total Rp 49.450 correctly computed.
RBAC correctly gated: cashier sees only POS/Orders/Cashier Shift/Settings; no Void button; blocked from /api/platform/tenants (401/403).
Tenant isolation and subscription entitlements previously verified per main agent (27/27). No regressions observed.
PWA: manifest.json and /sw.js both serve 200. Service worker registration only in prod build (expected per note).

Multiple leftover 'Limit Test' tenants (T002/T003/T004) exist in DB from prior FREE-plan limit tests — consider a cleanup script or teardown fixture in seed.py to avoid cluttering platform tenant list.
seed_data_creation: Test-run artifacts created during QA: (1) new PAID order T001-O01-U003-20260905-112739-000006 for Rp 49.450 (subsequently voided by owner test); (2) one test category with name like 'TESTCAT_QA_<epoch>' created via owner UI (not deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend smoke suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_smoke_test.py — reusable. Multi-login within a single Playwright session is flaky (cookies + redirect racing) — prefer fresh page.goto to /login per role and always await wait_for_selector on the email input. Note residual 'Limit Test' tenants T002/T003/T004 (FREE) exist from earlier limit tests. Cashier at Outlet Jakarta always has an open shift; expect no open-shift modal.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Two React warnings ('Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' in Login) originate from calling navigate()/setState synchronously during Login render instead of inside useEffect. Fix: wrap the redirect-if-authenticated logic in useEffect.
